subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Grade 3 Mathematics: Multiplication, Division, Fractions & Area
overview: Grade 3 mathematics deepens students' conceptual understanding of place value, arithmetic operations, algebraic thinking, measurement, and geometry through rigorous problem-solving routines.
competencies: Demonstrate computational fluency and conceptual flexibility across grade-level operations.
Apply visual models, tape diagrams, and equations to represent and solve multi-step contextual word problems.
Analyze geometric shapes, measurement units, and spatial relationships.
Construct viable mathematical arguments and critique the reasoning of peers.

modules.title: Properties of Multiplication and Division and Solving Problems with Units of 2–5 and 10
modules.description: Building deep conceptual understanding of multiplication as equal groups, arrays, and division as fair share/quotitive groups.

topics.title: Multiplication as Equal Groups and Arrays
topics.description: Relating repeated addition to multiplication equations and rectangular arrays.

topics.title: Division as an Unknown Factor Problem
topics.description: Understanding division as partitioning into equal sets or determining group size.

topics.title: Commutative and Distributive Properties
topics.description: Decomposing difficult multiplication facts into known smaller multiples (e.g. 7x4 = 5x4 + 2x4).

modules.title: Place Value and Problem Solving with Units of Measure
modules.description: Telling time to the nearest minute, solving elapsed time problems, and estimating and measuring liquid volume and mass.

topics.title: Time to the Minute and Elapsed Time
topics.description: Using number lines to calculate elapsed minutes forward and backward.

topics.title: Liquid Volume and Mass Measurement
topics.description: Using liters, grams, and kilograms with vertical scales and balance beams.

topics.title: Rounding to the Nearest 10 and 100
topics.description: Using vertical number lines to round two- and three-digit numbers.

modules.title: Multiplication and Division with Units of 0, 1, 6–9, and Multiples of 10
modules.description: Achieving fluency in all single-digit multiplication and division facts up to 100, and multiplying single-digit numbers by multiples of 10.

topics.title: Multiplication and Division with 6, 7, 8, and 9
topics.description: Using arrays, tape diagrams, and the distributive property for higher single-digit facts.

topics.title: Multiplying by Multiples of 10
topics.description: Using place value patterns to multiply single digits by 10, 20, 30... 90.

modules.title: Multiplication and Area
modules.description: Connecting multiplication to geometry by tiling rectangles with unit squares and discovering the area formula: Length x Width.

topics.title: Foundations of Area and Tiling
topics.description: Covering planar figures with unit squares without gaps or overlaps.

topics.title: Area Formula and Decomposing Rectangles
topics.description: Multiplying side lengths to find area and decomposing composite L-shaped figures.

modules.title: Fractions as Numbers on the Number Line
modules.description: Defining unit fractions (1/b), building fractions as copies of unit fractions, and placing fractions on the number line.

topics.title: Partitioning a Whole into Equal Parts
topics.description: Understanding unit fractions (1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 1/6, 1/8) as equal shares of a unit whole.

topics.title: Fractions on the Number Line
topics.description: Locating fractions between 0 and 1, and fractions greater than 1, on number lines.

topics.title: Equivalent Fractions and Comparing Fractions
topics.description: Recognizing equivalent fractions with visual fraction strips and same-size models.
